```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

spark = SparkSession.builder \
    .appName("AD688_JobFacts") \
    .config("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC") \
    .getOrCreate()
spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")

jobs_clean = spark.read.csv(
    "./outputs/api_job_facts_cleaned.csv",
    header=True,
    inferSchema=True,
    multiLine=True,
    escape='"'
)

# use this clean table for all downstream analysis
jobs_clean.createOrReplaceTempView("job_facts")
spark.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM job_facts").show()
spark.sql("SELECT * FROM job_facts LIMIT 50").toPandas()



```
